# Cohesive Insurance

> Cohesive Insurance Services is a licensed, independent insurance agency for small businesses in the United States. We compare quotes from several carriers and help owners get covered and send certificates of insurance (COIs) to customers and general contractors. We serve businesses in every state except California.

Licensed producer: Kevin Zhang, NPN 22277482. Phone: (929) 594-5450. Website: https://www.cohesiveinsure.com

## Who we insure

- Contractors and trades: roofers, general contractors, remodelers, electricians, plumbers, HVAC, painters, carpenters, masonry, concrete, flooring, tile, siding, tree services, landscapers, pool contractors, handymen, snow removal, pressure washing and more
- Cleaning and janitorial companies
- Restaurants, bars, cafes, bakeries, food trucks and caterers
- Churches and houses of worship
- Owners of commercial buildings

## Coverage

General liability, workers' compensation, commercial property, commercial auto, umbrella and excess, professional liability, and liquor liability.

## Prices

Many trade pages show real prices from our own book, each labelled as a policy we bound or a quote. They are not averages.

- Roofers: a roofer at about $475K revenue, $150K subcontracted and one W-2 employee came in at $1,795/yr with us for occurrence general liability. Larger roofers pay more, and the price moves mostly with revenue and subcontracted work. Prices by revenue: https://www.cohesiveinsure.com/insurance/roofer. Each roofer state page shows whether a price applies in that state.

## En español (Spanish-language pages)

We answer in Spanish by phone, text and email, from the quote to the certificates. Carrier documents and policies are issued in English, and we explain them in Spanish. Each Spanish page has a Spanish quote form.

- [Seguro para contratistas (contractor insurance, in Spanish)](https://www.cohesiveinsure.com/es/seguro/contratistas)
- [Seguro para techadores (roofer insurance, in Spanish)](https://www.cohesiveinsure.com/es/seguro/techadores): a roofer at about $475K revenue came in at $1,795/yr with us, and a roofing company at about $1.3M revenue with $800K subcontracted came in at $7,497/yr (general liability quotes, not bound policies).
- [Seguro para contratistas generales (general contractor insurance, in Spanish)](https://www.cohesiveinsure.com/es/seguro/contratistas-generales)
- [Seguro para contratistas de remodelación (remodeler insurance, in Spanish)](https://www.cohesiveinsure.com/es/seguro/remodelacion)
- [Seguro para restaurantes mexicanos (Mexican restaurant insurance, in Spanish)](https://www.cohesiveinsure.com/es/seguro/restaurantes-mexicanos): restaurants we insure pay $2,932/yr (general liability), $3,320/yr and $5,052/yr (general liability and property).

## Getting a quote

Every insurance page has a short quote form at the bottom (the "Get my quote" button). You can also call (929) 594-5450.
